First, we multiply each component of $v$ by $4$ and each component of $w$ by $2.$ Then, we add the vectors:

$$
\begin{aligned}4v+2w & =4\cdot [\begin{aligned}5 \\ -3 \\ 2 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+2\cdot [\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 9 \\ -2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}20 \\ -12 \\ 8 \\ -4 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 18 \\ -4 \\ 6 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}20+(-2) \\ -12+18 \\ 8+(-4) \\ -4+6 \\ 0+(-2)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}18 \\ 6 \\ 4 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
